topic.label: Mechanical Engineering
topic.desc: Mechanical Engineering: analysis and design of machines, structures, thermal-fluid systems and controls.

concepts: Forces, equilibrium, stress, strain and deflection in bars, beams, shafts and pressure vessels.
Kinematics and kinetics of particles, rigid bodies and mechanisms, and vibration of mechanical systems.
Energy conversion, power and refrigeration cycles, fluid statics and internal and external flows.
Conduction, convection and radiation and the design of heat exchangers and thermal management.
Design of machine elements, tolerancing, materials selection and manufacturing processes.
Modelling and feedback control of dynamic systems with sensors, actuators and embedded code.
skills: Resolves forces and moments on rigid bodies and trusses and checks that every equilibrium equation sums to zero.
Computes shear, moment and deflection for beams and checks maxima against superposition tables.
Runs finite element stress models of parts and checks mesh convergence and hand-calculation agreement.
Computes positions, velocities and accelerations of linkages and checks loop-closure equations.
Finds natural frequencies and mode shapes of multi-degree-of-freedom systems and checks them against FEA modal results.
Selects stiffness and damping to isolate vibration and checks transmissibility at operating frequency.
Analyses Rankine, Brayton and refrigeration cycles with property tables and checks first and second law balances.
Sizes pipes and pumps with Darcy friction and minor losses and checks Reynolds regime and head balance.
Sets up computational flow simulations and checks mesh independence and conservation of mass and momentum.
Models conduction and convection paths as resistance networks and checks the heat balance at each node.
Sizes exchangers by LMTD and effectiveness-NTU methods and checks both methods agree.
Designs fins and airflow to keep component temperatures within limits and checks results with a transient thermal model.
Selects gears and bearings for load and life and checks bending, contact stress and L10 life.
Computes worst-case and statistical tolerance stacks and checks fit requirements against GD and T callouts.
Chooses machining, casting or additive routes and checks cycle time, cost and achievable tolerance.
Tunes PID gains for a plant model and checks step response, overshoot and stability margins.
Builds state space models from equations of motion and checks controllability and observability.
Plans robot arm or mobile robot trajectories over ROS and checks joint limits and collision clearance.
